title: SemanticProposal
description: What the LLM submits through api_re_semantics propose. Stored verbatim; grants zero confidence by policy (llm_proposal cap = 0.0). The proposal is a hypothesis with a shape, not a truth.

subject.description: observation_id / canonical_key / endpoint the interpretation is about

evidence_refs.description: Capture/observation IDs the model believes support this. The engine checks them; if they do not support the claim, that is recorded as evidence against, not a rejection.
